cues.text: Start with one trip, from Legazpi Grand Central Terminal to Tabaco City.
cues.onscreen: A road from a terminal (A) in Legazpi to Tabaco City (B); a jeepney waits at A.

cues.text: Which jeepney do you ride, when do you arrive, and what do you pay?
cues.onscreen: Three chips: "Which jeepney?", "When do I arrive?", "How much?".

cues.text: In Albay, jeepneys, tricycles, buses, and UV Express vans publish no machine-readable routes, stops, or fares.
cues.onscreen: Four vehicle cards; a red stamp "NO ROUTE DATA".

cues.text: Many leave only when full, and since September 28, the base jeepney fare is 14 pesos for the first four kilometers.
cues.onscreen: Fare card "₱14.00 for the first 4 km · ₱2.00 per km after · 20% discount for students, seniors, PWD". Source: Daguno-Bersamina, 2026 (LTFRB).

cues.text: Zoom out to the whole province.
cues.onscreen: Albay as a field of 720 barangay dots.

cues.text: Albay has 720 barangays and nearly 1.4 million people in 18 cities and municipalities.
cues.onscreen: "ALBAY · 18 cities and municipalities · 720 barangays · 1,379,398 residents" (2024 Census, Proclamation No. 973, s. 2025).

cues.text: Bicol is one of six regions where fewer than 80 percent of people live within two hours of a public hospital that can do essential surgery.
cues.onscreen: Card "Bicol: fewer than 80% within 2 hours of essential surgery". Source: Lim et al., 2023.

cues.text: Target 11.2 asks for transport accessible to all, and Target 3.8 for health care people can use without hardship.
cues.onscreen: Chips "SDG 11.2 · accessible transport" and "SDG 3.8 · health care without hardship"; "SDG 10.2 · inclusion".

cues.text: In Albay, there was nothing to measure them against.
cues.onscreen: The chips meet over an empty chart: "no baseline data".

cues.text: Now, an emergency.
cues.onscreen: An ambulance with flashing light.

cues.text: The nearest hospital may be full, may lack the right level of care, or may cost more than the family can pay.
cues.onscreen: Three hospitals: "FULL", "Level 1 only", "₱₱₱".

cues.text: The Department of Health publishes where hospitals are and how many beds they have, but not which beds are free.
cues.onscreen: Card "Published: location, bed capacity · Not published: free beds". Source: DOH Freedom of Information Unit, personal communication, September 22, 2026.

cues.text: So how does a crew know, in minutes, which hospital can take the patient?
cues.onscreen: "Right care · Free bed · Fair price · In minutes" with a question mark.

cues.text: This is where MCS comes into play.
cues.onscreen: The letters M, C and S drop in and unfold into Mathematical, Computational, Sciences.

cues.text: Objective one: a timetable graph from open data that routes by arrival, fare, and transfers, within vehicle road limits.
cues.onscreen: Panel OBJECTIVE 1 · TIMETABLE GRAPH; a time-expanded graph with ride, wait and transfer arcs; ten vehicle classes.

cues.text: Dijkstra's search gives the exact earliest arrival, and the regulated fare is proven monotone and subadditive.
cues.onscreen: The earliest-arrival path lights gold; equations for the mean travel time and the regulated fare f(ℓ₁+ℓ₂) ≤ f(ℓ₁)+f(ℓ₂).

cues.text: Objective two: measure who is left behind, with the Gini, Theil, and Palma measures, and split inequality within and between towns.
cues.onscreen: Panel OBJECTIVE 2 · INEQUALITY; a Lorenz curve; cumulative accessibility and the exact Theil split; S1: 86.0% between municipalities.

cues.text: Objective three: e-mail agents gather bed reports, and an early-stopping search finds the nearest hospital that can take the patient.
cues.onscreen: Panel OBJECTIVE 3 · HOSPITAL MODE; agents exchange tokened e-mails; the route skips the full hospital; suitability rule and nearest suitable hospital.

cues.text: In an emergency, payment never delays the route.
cues.onscreen: Badge "Acuity 1–2: payment filter off · payment gap = 0" (RA 10932).

cues.text: Objective four: MAP-A, one app that puts all of this on a phone, even without a signal.
cues.onscreen: Panel OBJECTIVE 4 · THE APP; a phone with the MAP-A trip planner and hospital mode; "offline".

cues.text: Twelve propositions, proven, then checked: 618 of 618 trips, 5,200 of 5,200 hospital queries, and all 200 forged replies rejected.
cues.onscreen: Twelve green checks; cards 618/618 earliest-arrival queries, 5,200/5,200 hospital queries, 200/200 forged replies rejected.

cues.text: Fifteen of the sixteen app features work, and it runs with no connection at all.
cues.onscreen: Cards 11,620 vehicle-class pairs, 0 violations · 15 of 16 checklist features working · runs offline.

cues.text: MAP-A will not add one bed to Albay.
cues.onscreen: Boom. Screen darkens; the line appears in white.

cues.text: But it will tell a rider what to ride and what to pay, and tell a crew which hospital can take the patient now.
cues.onscreen: The line appears in gold.

cues.text: Distance tells you where the hospital is.
cues.onscreen: "Distance tells you where the hospital is." in white.

cues.text: Access tells you whether it can help in time.
cues.onscreen: "Access tells you whether it can help in time." in gold.
